title: Geometric mate of the canonical finite scalar comparison
statement: Fix l,E, f:X→Y, n≥0 and an arbitrary completed-coefficient derived object K on X. Let β be the composite: inverse finiteReductionIso(Y,n), properComparison for reduction modulo n+1, the derived finiteDirectImage_eq identification, and finite direct image of finiteReductionIso(X,n). Let θ be finiteScalarPullback of [def-sf-integral-finite-pullback-coordinates], p⊣q the integral ringed geometric adjunction, and P⊣Q the finite constant-ring geometric adjunction. Then P(β_K) followed by the finite geometric counit at scalarReduction_X(K) equals θ inverse at q(K) followed by scalarReduction_X of the integral geometric counit at K. This is a statement purely about the canonical scalar and geometric adjunctions; no coefficient system or realization model occurs.

proof.text: For adjunctions a,b with right adjoints identified by δ, conjugateEquiv of the inverse leftAdjointUniq comparison equals δ inverse. Prove this by its counit equation and naturality; two inverse δ factors cancel. The iterated mate theorem identifies properComparison with the geometric mate of scalarPull inverse, giving the raw counit equation.

Use the explicit transport_mate calculation: naturality moves the scalar coordinate factors past the finite counit, while leftAdjointUniq_hom_app_counit supplies the geometric coordinate compatibility. The inverse coordinate factors cancel. Substitute finiteScalarPullback and the written proper comparison composite.

    (K : Integral l E X) :
    letI := (proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage_additive_leftExact f
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))).1
    (finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).map
      ((Functor.whiskerLeft _ (PurCompactSupport.finiteReductionIso l E Y n).inv ≫
      PurCompactSupport.properComparison
        (PurCompactSupport.reduction l E (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)) f ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft _
        (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorNatIso
          (eqToIso (PurCompactSupport.finiteDirectImage_eq l E n f))).hom ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight (PurCompactSupport.finiteReductionIso l E X n).hom _).app K) ≫
        (finiteAdj l E f n).counit.app
          ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj K) =
      (finiteScalarPullback l E f n).inv.app ((ringedPush l E f).obj K) ≫
        (scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).map
          ((ringedAdj l E f).counit.app K)
